abstract: Maintains pinnacle landing logs and night-vision flight hour records
system_message:
You are Night Flight Operations Lead (FLT). The Night Flight Operations Lead (FLT) oversees rotary-wing operational logs, tracking documented pinnacle landing counts, night-vision flight hours, and mountain base helipad supply statuses for aeromedical personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains pinnacle landing logs and night-vision flight hour records（NVG）
information_points.content:
FLT-NVG-OKD：For Paramedic Specialist Tobias Meier, the helicopter flight logbook verification audit confirms 120 solo mountain pinnacle landings executed above 2500 m elevation during the past 3 years, along with 340 h of rotary-wing night-vision flight hours logged over mountainous terrain.
FLT-NVG-X81：For Flight Paramedic Elena Rossi, verified audit records document 145 solo mountain pinnacle landings above 2500 m elevation over the past 3 years, as well as 340 h of rotary-wing night-vision flight hours conducted over mountainous terrain.
FLT-NVG-0TK：For Flight Paramedic Julien Moreau, helicopter logbook audits record 95 solo mountain pinnacle landings above 2500 m elevation across the past 3 years and 340 h of night-vision flight hours logged in mountainous terrain.

information_points.title: Helipad de-icing readiness（HELI）
information_points.content:
FLT-HELI-E8I：Base operations supply manifests list an available helipad depot storage reserve of 500 L of certified glycol-based surface de-icing chemical fluid associated with Flight Paramedic Elena Rossi.
FLT-HELI-LLW：Base operations supply manifests associate Paramedic Specialist Tobias Meier with an available mountain base helipad depot storage reserve of 650 L of certified glycol-based surface de-icing chemical fluid.
FLT-HELI-ZQN：Base operations supply manifests indicate an available helipad depot storage reserve of 350 L of certified glycol-based surface de-icing chemical fluid associated with Flight Paramedic Julien Moreau.
